persona.message: My bank account number is 55667788990. I do not know the IFSC code. I am not sure whose name is on the account. What should I do now?

client.text:
Please don't submit again until you are sure the account is in your own name. The same rejection would happen again.

**How to check whose name is on the account:**
- Look at your bank passbook. The name is printed on the first page, along with the account number and often the IFSC code.
- Or visit your bank branch with your Aadhaar or Voter ID and ask them to confirm the account holder's name and give you the IFSC code. This is free and takes a few minutes.
- If you use mobile banking, the app usually shows the account holder's name and the IFSC code.

**If the account is in someone else's name** (for example a son, daughter, or spouse), open a new savings account in your own name at any bank branch. Carry your Aadhaar or Voter ID, and ask for the IFSC code when the account is opened.

**Once you have the IFSC code and know the account is in your name,** send me both the account number and the IFSC code. I will check your eligibility again and then file the new application with your details. Please also tell me your full name as it appears on the bank account, since the officer will compare it.
